points.description: States that height is the length of the longest path (maximum number of edges, or equivalently levels/nodes if the student states that convention) in the tree.
points.partial_credit: Half credit if the student gives a path length but omits 'longest'/maximum (e.g. just 'a path length' or 'depth of a node').

points.description: Specifies that the path runs from the root down to a leaf (any leaf, i.e. the deepest leaf).

rubric.notes: Full marks for a definition equivalent to 'the length of the longest root-to-leaf path'. Part marks if only one of the two ideas (longest/length; root to leaf) is given or either is vague. No marks for unrelated definitions such as number of nodes or number of children.
